To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the 3G/3GPP SCM and the IMTMCM are very similar in their modeling approaches, and they both are based on a deterministic ray-tracing technique; 2) the spatial correlation properties of the 3D SCM are very similar to the 2D SCM; 3) the spatial multiplexing performance of MIMO channels is greatly influenced by spatial correlation, while the spatial diversity performance of the MIMO channels is less sensitive to the spatial correlation;

the IMT-Advance MCM is more general and flexible compared to the 3G SCM and that the spatial diversity and multiplexing gain performance of the 3g SCM is lower than the IMT-ADV MCM, but the 3G MCM is more suitable for the current and future cellular systems
the IMT- Advanced MCM is more suitable for MIMO systems with a large number of antennas and high data rates.
